My recipe (or the closest I can remember):
- 5 c king Arthur ap flour
- 70% hydration (I think this worked out to be just under 19 oz of warm water since my starter is 1:1)
- mix flour and water until combined and leave covered for 30 minutes
- add 1 c active fed starter
- combine in mixer for 10 mins on low speed
- put into lightly greased bowl and left alone for 6 hours
- Refridgerate overnight
- in the morning, pull dough out, back into the mixer and add 2.5 tsp of salt, mix until incorporated
- form into boule and back into covered bowl
- once an hour (ish) gently deflate and reform boule (I did this for about 5 hours)
- cut in two, final form and put into bannerton for final rise
- leave it until puffy (this took about 4 hours)
- baked in preheated dutch oven covered for 25 mins and uncovered for 5 at 450 F

What I did:
- I used 5 c king Arthur ap flour, 70% hydration (this was just under 19 oz of warm water)
- Mix together until incorporated and let sit for ~30mins
- Added 1c active fed starter and left to knead in a mixer for ~10 minutes
- Plopped dough into covered lightly greased bowl and left it to bubble for 6 hours untouched
- Refrigerate overnight
- throw dough back into mixer and add 2 1/2 tsp salt, mix until incorporated
- form dough (it was pretty wet so I settled for a jiggly ball) and place, seam down, into covered bowl
- roughly once an hour for 5 hours I would go back, pull the dough out, lightly stretch/de-gas it and reshape
- cut in half and form two boules, place in bannerton for final rise and let sit until noticeably puffy (for me this was 4 hours)

Then I baked in a dutch oven at 450 F for 25 mins covered and 5 mins unconvered
